items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: we did everything from Charlie Mingus to whatever was happening back then... We played... 'Bags’ Groove,' Charlie Mingus

ctx.x: Were you responsible for sound effects, anything like that?

No we didn’t do that. No the strange thing about that show was that Godfrey had fallen in love with jazz. And we turned it into a jazz band. Sometimes it was a Dixieland band and Godfrey would play along with his ukulele, and he was very cooperative in wanting to learn the correct chords. And at other times he would give us free reign and we did everything from Charlie Mingus to whatever was happening back then, back then being 1959, 1960. We played amazingly hip things for the Arthur Godfrey Show. “Bags’…
And it was live too, right?
